Inbound CallTool still untracked. Q-014 image hop does not cancel the leaf (cycle 79). Do not edit slack.ts (#2393). Not A-006. Hermes on the new instance never sees the old isError (mcpServerCore.ts L164-173). Do not add POST retry. Cycle 106: inbound Hermes /mcp and loopback mcpFetch are different sockets. closeIdleConnections unused. Wrap-then-close still loses idle keep-alive CallTool after the four-way wait. Refuse at disableCron, not a close API. Platform nginx keepalive unverified (not in .platform). Cycle 107: after close, new Hermes /mcp is nginx 502 now (connect refused), not a 10 min 504. A-019 refuse at disableCron still stops CallTool before close so Hermes never hits that 502 on the dying instance. Cycle 108: ALB health is not the Hermes-stop. /health stays 200 until close so loopback can finish. A-019 refuse at disableCron is the only admission that leaves the listen up. Do not 503 /health during drain. Do not add HealthCheckPath from this cycle. Cycle 109: the deploy probe that can see Ok/healthy is not a drain signal. During the wait it would report healthy. A-019 refuse at disableCron still the gate. Do not describe-instances-health from runDrain. Cycle 110: A-019 window is weekly (Sunday 10:00 UTC recycle), not only on merge. Recycle never hits underlying_health_verdict. Do not disable InstanceRefreshEnabled (disk/patches). Cycle 111: Sunday+merge is sequential A-019 windows or a failed CI deploy while recycle alone overlaps. Not a three-process mesh. EB_TOTAL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS 2700 (deploy.yml L187) caps the run (capped_deadline L201-209; test L518-534). Recycle overlap continues without CI adding a listen(). Cycle 113: Sunday drain is not that hook. put-lifecycle-hook is on AutoScalingGroups[0] before Immutable update-environment (eb-deploy.sh L654-655; test L1066-1091 exactly one, before update). The surviving ASG after swap is never hooked. Cycle 110 same-ASG-hook is wrong after Immutable. A-019 refuse never runs if Terminating:Wait never happens. Park A-020: second put after verify. Cycle 114: guard still drains on two IMDS Terminated reads without checking the hook exists (asgLifecycleGuard.ts L232-296; test L267-283). disableCron is first in runDrain (server.ts L387). Missing hook: ASG does not wait (L12-15). 3m19s is two-instance overlap, not Terminating:Wait.
